alive.last_commit_message:
Charge goal usage on the newest goal so subagents cannot fail the turn (#1229)

Goal turns with running subagents failed with "revision conflict on
chat_goals <id>: expected N, found N+1". _charge_goal read the goal and
wrote its usage against that revision without retrying. A subagent's
usage charge, or an active-time settle, committed in between, and the
conflict escaped _add_usage into the tool loop, which saved it as the
turn's error. The response's tokens were also never charged to the goal.

The debit is now planned on the newest saved goal through revise_latest,
so a lost race re-reads and re-plans, and both debits are kept. A charge
inside a caller's transaction is unchanged: that unit retries as a whole.
